source(output(
		Infant_Birth_Weight as string,
		Requesting_Provider_NPI as string,
		Requesting_Hospital_Tax_ID as string,
		Type_Of_Service as string,
		Received_Date as string,
		Requesting_Hospital_Name as string,
		Place_Of_Service as string,
		LowService_Date as string,
		Admission_Date as string,
		Requesting_Provider_Name as string,
		Infant_Gestational_Age as string,
		Member_ID as string,
		Authorization_Number as string,
		Diagnosis_Code as string,
		Medicaid_ID as string,
		HighService_Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @MARKET VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @MARKET1 VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @MARKET2 VARCHAR(100)  SET @MARKET = SUBSTRING( CAST(? AS VARCHAR) ,1, CHARINDEX(\'|\',CAST(? AS VARCHAR))-1)  IF(CHARINDEX(\',\',@MARKET)!=0) 	BEGIN 		SET @MARKET1 = SUBSTRING( @MARKET ,1, CHARINDEX(\',\',@MARKET)-1)  		SET @MARKET2 = SUBSTRING( @MARKET ,CHARINDEX(\',\',REVERSE(@MARKET))+1, CHARINDEX(\',\',REVERSE(@MARKET))-1)  	END ELSE 	BEGIN 		SET @MARKET1 = @MARKET 		SET @MARKET2 = \'\'     END   SELECT MARKET,       [Member_ID]       ,[Medicaid_ID]       ,[Infant_Gestational_Age]       ,[Infant_Birth_Weight]       ,[Admission_Date]       ,[Place_Of_Service]       ,[Type_Of_Service]       ,Diagnosis_Code       ,[LowService_Date]       ,[HighService_Date]       ,[Requesting_Provider_Name]       ,[Requesting_Provider_NPI]       ,[Requesting_Hospital_Name]       ,[Requesting_Hospital_Tax_ID]       ,[Authorization_Number]       ,Received_Date   FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[POMELO_NICU_AUTHS_EXTRACT]   WHERE Market = @MARKET1   UNION   SELECT MARKET,       [Member_ID]       ,[Medicaid_ID]       ,[Infant_Gestational_Age]       ,[Infant_Birth_Weight]       ,[Admission_Date]       ,[Place_Of_Service]       ,[Type_Of_Service]       ,Diagnosis_Code       ,[LowService_Date]       ,[HighService_Date]       ,[Requesting_Provider_Name]       ,[Requesting_Provider_NPI]       ,[Requesting_Hospital_Name]       ,[Requesting_Hospital_Tax_ID]       ,[Authorization_Number]       ,Received_Date   FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[POMELO_NICU_AUTHS_EXTRACT]   WHERE Market = @MARKET2    ORDER BY [Member_ID],[Authorization_Number]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTablePOMELONICUAUTHSEXTRACT
